### FHIR mapping
`https://build.fhir.org/medicationrequest.html` — the `MedicationRequest` model at [care/emr/models/medication_request.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/models/medication_request.py) maps directly. ### Key attributes

Source: [care/emr/models/medication_request.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/models/medication_request.py) (Django model) + [care/emr/resources/medication/request/spec.py](file:///Users/rithviknishad/ohc.network/care/care/emr/resources/medication/request/spec.py) (`MedicationRequestSpec` = create/write spec).

| Field | Required on create? | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | required | `MedicationRequestStatus` enum |
| `status_reason` | optional | `StatusReason` enum |
| `intent` | required | `MedicationRequestIntent` enum |
| `category` | required | `MedicationRequestCategory` enum |
| `priority` | required | `MedicationRequestPriority` enum |
| `do_not_perform` | required (bool, no default) | model field has no default, so must be explicitly true/false |
| `medication` | conditionally required | Coding bound to `CARE_MEDICATION_VALUESET`; mutually exclusive with `requested_product` (validator: exactly one of `medication` / `requested_product` must be set) |
| `requested_product` | conditionally required | UUID4 referencing `ProductKnowledge`; mutually exclusive with `medication`; must belong to same facility as encounter or have no facility set |
| `dosage_instruction` | required (list, can be empty `[]`) | list of `DosageInstruction` objects (see below) |
| `authored_on` | required | datetime |
| `note` | optional | free text |
| `dispense_status` | optional | `MedicationRequestDispenseStatus` enum |
| `encounter` | required | UUID4, validated to exist |
| `patient` | derived, not user-supplied | set from `encounter.patient` in `perform_extra_deserialization` |
| `requester` | optional | UUID4 referencing a `User`; if supplied, requester must independently have `can_update_encounter_clinical_data` on the encounter (checked in viewset `authorize_create`) |
| `prescription` | optional | UUID4 referencing an existing `MedicationRequestPrescription` in the same encounter; mutually exclusive with `create_prescription` |
| `create_prescription` | optional | inline object `{name, note, alternate_identifier}` — creates or reuses (by `alternate_identifier` + encounter) a `MedicationRequestPrescription`; if an existing prescription is found and its status isn't `active`, raises `ValidationError("Prescription is not active")` |

**`DosageInstruction` sub-object fields** (all in `care/emr/resources/medication/request/spec.py`):
- `sequence: int | None`
- `text: str | None`
- `additional_instruction: list[Coding]` bound to `CARE_ADDITIONAL_INSTRUCTION_VALUESET`, optional
- `patient_instruction: str | None`
- `timing: Timing | None` → `Timing.repeat: TimingRepeat` (`frequency: int`, `period: Decimal`, `period_unit: TimingUnit`, and at least one of `bounds_duration` / `bounds_range` / `bounds_period` — enforced by a `model_validator`), `Timing.code: Coding | None`
- `as_needed_boolean: bool` — **required, no default** (note: this is a plain bool field named like a FHIR choice-type but always present)
- `as_needed_for: Coding | None` bound to `CARE_AS_NEEDED_REASON_VALUESET`
- `site: Coding | None` bound to `CARE_BODY_SITE_VALUESET`
- `route: Coding | None` bound to `CARE_ROUTE_VALUESET`
- `method: Coding | None` bound to `CARE_ADMINISTRATION_METHOD_VALUESET`
- `dose_and_rate: DoseAndRate | None` → `{type: DoseType, dose_range | dose_quantity}`
- `max_dose_per_period: DoseRange | None`

### 2. Form fields (create/edit — `MedicationRequestQuestion.tsx`)

Top-level (per medication row):

| Field | Required? | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medication / product | required (implicit — row exists only once a medicine or product is picked) | search/select (`MedicationValueSetSelect` — value-set code **or** internal product knowledge) | none |
| Dose (quantity or range) | **required** (`MEDICATION_REQUEST_FIELDS.DOSAGE`) | numeric + unit combobox (`ComboboxQuantityInput`) — "Start Dose"/"End Dose" pair when a range | `1 {unit}` when a product's base unit is known |
| Frequency | **required** (`MEDICATION_REQUEST_FIELDS.FREQUENCY`) | smart autocomplete (`DosageFrequencyInput`) accepting M-A-N shorthand ("1-0-1"), FHIR codes (BID/TID/QD/Q6H…), "SOS", "STAT", or freeform text | none |
| Duration (scheduling bound) | optional (`MEDICATION_REQUEST_FIELDS.DURATION`) | `DurationInput` — Duration / Range / Period sub-modes | none (open-ended) |
| PRN (as-needed) toggle | optional | checkbox/toggle (`as_needed_boolean`) | `false` (auto-set `true` for consumable products) |
| PRN reason | conditional — enabled only when PRN is on | value-set select (`system-as-needed-reason`) | none |
| Route | optional | value-set select (`system-route`) | none |
| Site | optional | value-set select (`system-body-site`) | none |
| Method | optional | value-set select (`system-administration-method`) | none |
| Additional instruction(s) | optional | `Code[]` (rendered read-only in table, editable via instruction editor) | none |
| Patient instruction / Sig | optional | free text | none |
| Intent | optional (has a select, but not validated as required) | select — `proposal`, `plan`, `order`, `original_order`, `reflex_order`, `filler_order`, `instance_order` | `"order"` (from `parseMedicationStringToRequest`) |
| Requester | optional (defaults to current user) | `UserSelector` | current logged-in user |
| Note (per-medication) | optional | textarea | none |
| Prescription-level note | optional | textarea, placeholder `t("prescription_note_placeholder")` | none |

**Not exposed in the UI at all** (set silently by code): `status` (defaults `"active"`), `priority` (defaults `"routine"`), `category` (defaults `"inpatient"`) — see Suspected Code Issues.

### 3. i18n display labels

**Status** (`medication_status__{value}` in [en.json](care_fe/public/locale/en.json#L3460-L3470)):
- `active` → "Active"
- `cancelled` → "Cancelled"
- `completed` → "Completed"
- `draft` → "Draft"
- `ended` → "Ended"
- `entered_in_error` → "Entered in Error"
- `on_hold` → "On Hold"
- `unknown` → "Unknown"
- (also present but not part of `MEDICATION_REQUEST_STATUS`: `intended` → "Intended", `not_taken` → "Not Taken", `stopped` → "Stopped" — likely shared with `MedicationStatement`/`MedicationAdministration` status sets)

**Prescription status** (`prescription_status__{value}`):
- `active` → "Active", `cancelled` → "Cancelled", `completed` → "Completed"

**Status reason** (`MEDICATION_REQUEST_STATUS_REASON`: `altchoice, clarif, drughigh, hospadm, labint, non_avail, preg, salg, sddi, sdupther, sintol, surg, washout`): **no `{PREFIX}__{value}` i18n keys found anywhere in `en.json`**, and no UI control renders this field — see Ambiguities.

**Category** (`inpatient|outpatient|community|discharge`): generic (non-prefixed) keys `"inpatient": "Inpatient"` and `"discharge": "Discharge"` exist; **no `"outpatient"` or `"community"` keys found**, and the field has no UI control anyway.

**Priority** (`stat|urgent|asap|routine`): generic keys `"stat": "STAT"`, `"urgent": "Urgent"`, `"asap": "ASAP"`, `"routine": "Routine"` exist (shared with encounter priority), but priority also has no UI control in the medication request form.

**Intent** (`MEDICATION_REQUEST_INTENT`): rendered via raw string transform `intent.replace(/_/g, " ")` with CSS `capitalize` — **not translated through i18n at all** (e.g., `original_order` renders as "Original order", not from any `en.json` key).

**Field labels used in the form/table**: `dosage` → "Dosage", `frequency` → "Frequency", `duration` → "Duration", `instructions` → "Instructions", `route` → "Route", `site` → "Site", `method` → "Method", `intent` → "Intent", `medicine` → "Medicine", `note` → "Note".

**Placeholders/buttons**: `add_medication` → "Add Medication" (with `_one`/`_other` i18next plural forms "Add Medication" / "Add another Medication"), `select_route` → "Select Route", `select_site` → "Select site", `select_method` → "Select method", `select_intent` → "Select intent", `select_requester` → "Select requester", `select_prn_reason` → "Select reason for PRN", `frequency_placeholder` → "eg. 1-0-1", `duration_placeholder` → "eg. 5 days", `start_dose`/`end_dose` → "Start Dose"/"End Dose".

**Tabs/sections**: `ENCOUNTER_TAB__medicines` → "Medicines"; within it: `prescriptions` → "Prescriptions", `medication_statements` → "Medication Statements", `medicine_administration` → "Medicine Administration", `dispense_history` → "Dispense History".

**Discontinue dialog**: `discontinue_medication` → "Discontinue Medication", `discontinue_medication_group_title` → "Discontinue Medication Group", `discontinue_medication_description`, `discontinue_medication_group_description`.

**Pharmacy nav**: `prescription_queue` → "Prescription Queue".

### 4. Routes

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/facility/:facilityId/patient/:patientId/encounter/:encounterId/questionnaire/:slug` (slug = `medication_request`) | Prescribe/edit medications (questionnaire-driven form) |
| `/facility/:facilityId/patient/:patientId/prescription/:prescriptionId/print` | Print one prescription |
| `/facility/:facilityId/patient/:patientId/encounter/:encounterId/prescriptions/print` | Print all prescriptions |
| `/facility/:facilityId/patient/:patientId/encounter/:encounterId/type/:productType/administrations/print` | Print drug/intake administration chart |
| `/facility/:facilityId/locations/:locationId/medication_requests` | Pharmacy "Prescription Queue" (dispense side) |
| `/facility/:facilityId/locations/:locationId/medication_dispense` | Pharmacy "℞ Dispense" |

Navigation: sidebar (facility → location → Pharmacy group) for the pharmacy queue; within an encounter, the "Medicines" tab (`ENCOUNTER_TAB__medicines`) is reached via the encounter tab bar or shortcut `g m`.

### 5. Frontend permission gating

There is **no dedicated medication-request permission slug**. Access is entirely derived from generic encounter/clinical-data permissions in [EncounterProvider.tsx](care_fe/src/pages/Encounters/utils/EncounterProvider.tsx#L155-L186):

- `canReadClinicalData` = `canViewClinicalData` (slug `can_view_clinical_data`) **OR** `canReadEncounterClinicalData` (slug `can_read_encounter_clinical_data`)
- `canWriteClinicalData` = `canReadClinicalData` **AND** `canWriteSelectedEncounter` (facility-scoped + encounter is the primary/selected one + not an inactive encounter status)

`MedicationRequestTable` and `PrescriptionView` consume these as `canAccess`/`canWrite` props ([MedicationRequestTable/index.tsx](care_fe/src/components/Medicine/MedicationRequestTable/index.tsx#L58-L60)), gating the "Create"/"Edit"/"Print" buttons and the "Administer"/"Discontinue" buttons in `AdministrationTab`. Slug constants defined in [common/Permissions.tsx](care_fe/src/common/Permissions.tsx#L5,#L14-L18); hook is `useHasPermission` / `usePermissions` in [context/PermissionContext.tsx](care_fe/src/context/PermissionContext.tsx#L67).

### 6. Keyboard shortcuts ([keyboardShortcuts.json](care_fe/src/config/keyboardShortcuts.json))

| Context | Key | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encounter` | `k` | `add-medication-request` | "Add Medication" |
| `encounter` | `g m` | `medicines` | "Go to Medicines Tab" |
| `encounter` | `shift+d` | `dispense` | "Dispense Medication" |
| `global` | `shift+enter` | `submit-action` | "Submit Current Action" — applies to the prescribe form submit |
| `facility:pharmacy` | `shift+d` | `dispense-button` | "Dispense Medication" |
| `facility:pharmacy` | `shift+r` | `medication-return` | "Return Medication" |
| `facility:pharmacy` | `shift+p` | `view-prescriptions` | "View Prescription" |

No medication-specific shortcut exists for Discontinue, Edit, or Print within the medicine tabs beyond the global `p`/`e`/`escape` generic actions.

### 7. `care.config.ts` flags

- `medicationValueSetSelectDefaultTab` (env `REACT_MEDICATION_VALUE_SET_SELECT_DEFAULT_TAB`) — controls whether the medication picker in the prescribe form ([MedicationValueSetSelect.tsx](care_fe/src/components/Questionnaire/MedicationValueSetSelect.tsx#L84,#L306-L311)) defaults to the **"Product"** tab (facility inventory/product knowledge) or the **"Value Set"** tab (generic coded medication search). Values: `"valueset"` or default `"product"`.

No other medication-request-specific flags found in `care.config.ts`.

### 8. API calls

| Action | Typed API route | File |
|---|---|---|
| List medication requests for a patient/encounter | `GET /api/v1/patient/{patientId}/medication/request/` | [medicationRequestApi.ts](care_fe/src/types/emr/medicationRequest/medicationRequestApi.ts#L5-L15) |
| Create/update multiple medication requests (prescribe form save, discontinue, entered-in-error) | `POST /api/v1/patient/{patientId}/medication/request/upsert/` (`upsert`) | same file, used in `MedicationRequestQuestion.tsx` submit handler and `AdministrationTab.tsx` discontinue mutation |
| Update a single medication request | `PUT /api/v1/patient/{patientId}/medication/request/{id}/` (`update`) — defined but not observed called directly in the searched components (form uses `upsert` exclusively) | same file |
| Prescription (group) fetch | `prescriptionApi.get` | [PrescriptionView.tsx](care_fe/src/components/Medicine/PrescriptionView.tsx#L38-L42) |
| Product knowledge lookup (for template rehydration) | `productKnowledgeApi.retrieveProductKnowledge` | [MedicationRequestQuestion.tsx](care_fe/src/components/Questionnaire/QuestionTypes/MedicationRequestQuestion.tsx#L169-L179) |

The typed `update` route appears unused by any UI code found in this search — see Suspected Code Issues.

### 9. Ambiguities / unverified details

1. **No dedicated "Hold"/"Resume" action.** `MedicationRequestStatus` includes `on_hold`, and it's colored/labeled ("On Hold"), but I found **no UI control that sets a medication request to `on_hold`** — only "Discontinue" (→ `status: "ended"`) and "Entered in Error" (via delete-of-existing-record) are reachable from the UI. Needs confirmation whether `on_hold` is set only via questionnaire responses/backend logic, or is genuinely dead in the FE.
2. **`status_reason` field** (`MedicationRequestStatusReason` — altchoice/clarif/drughigh/etc.) has no i18n labels and no UI control anywhere in the searched files. Unclear if/where this is meant to be surfaced — flag to reviewer.
3. **`priority` and `category`** fields exist on the type and are defaulted in code (`routine`/`inpatient`) but have **no editable UI**. Confirm with product owner whether this is intentional (i.e., always fixed for now) before documenting them as "system-set, not user-editable."
4. **Medication Administration is confirmed to be a separate module/tab** ("Medicine Administration" sub-tab under the Medicines tab), operating on `MedicationAdministration` resources referencing a `MedicationRequest`. It supports Administer, Edit administration, and Discontinue (of the underlying request) — worth a separate concept doc per the user's own framing, cross-linked from Medication Request.
5. **`MedicationStatement` ("Medication Statements" tab)** is yet another distinct FHIR-adjacent concept (patient-reported/ongoing medications) that shares much of the same form code (`MedicationStatementQuestion.tsx`) but is a separate resource from `MedicationRequest`. Confirm whether this needs its own concept doc or a "related concepts" callout.
6. **"Prescription" is a CARE-specific grouping construct** (`PrescriptionStatus`: active/completed/cancelled) that batches `MedicationRequest`s for the pharmacy dispense workflow. It is not itself a FHIR resource I could confirm; needs clarification on its FHIR mapping (possibly `MedicationRequest.group_identifier` or a custom extension) before writing user docs that reference "Prescriptions."
7. **Discontinuing a group** ("Discontinue Medication Group") discontinues *all active requests sharing the same product* — confirm this grouping logic (by `group.productId`) is the intended clinical behavior worth documenting distinctly from single-item discontinue.

### 10. Suspected code issues

- [medicationRequestApi.ts](care_fe/src/types/emr/medicationRequest/medicationRequestApi.ts#L18-L22): `update` (single `PUT`) route is defined but no calling code was found in the components searched — all creation/editing/discontinue flows use `upsert` instead. Possibly dead code.
- [MedicationRequestQuestion.tsx](care_fe/src/components/Questionnaire/QuestionTypes/MedicationRequestQuestion.tsx#L2088-L2094): the Intent select renders `intent.replace(/_/g, " ")` directly instead of an i18n key — inconsistent with the rest of the app's i18n convention (e.g., status uses `medication_status__{value}`), and will not localize for non-English deployments.
- `priority` and `category` are part of `MedicationRequestCreate`/`MedicationRequestRead` and drive `MEDICATION_REQUEST_STATUS_COLORS`-style logic elsewhere in the codebase, yet the create form never lets a user set them — every prescribed medication is silently `routine`/`inpatient`. This may be an oversight rather than a deliberate design decision.
- `MedicationRequestStatusReason` (`MEDICATION_REQUEST_STATUS_REASON`) has zero i18n coverage and zero UI wiring — looks like a partially-implemented feature (type/constants exist, no consuming UI).
- [medicationRequest.ts](care_fe/src/types/emr/medicationRequest/medicationRequest.ts#L96-L98) `medication_status__intended`, `medication_status__not_taken`, `medication_status__stopped` exist in `en.json` but have no corresponding value in `MEDICATION_REQUEST_STATUS` — likely leftover/shared from `MedicationStatement` or `MedicationAdministration` enums; verify before treating them as Medication Request statuses.
Both dossiers are in. Let me read them in full.
Now the frontend dossier.

content.text:
Research is done. Here's the merged picture for **Clinical / Medication Request** — please review before I write anything.

## Proposed flow list (in the order a user meets them)

| # | Flow | Covers |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | **Prescribe a Medication** | Create a `MedicationRequest` in an encounter — pick a medicine/product, set dose, frequency, duration, PRN, route/site/method, optionally group into a Prescription, optionally add from a patient's medication history |
| 2 | **Edit a Prescription's Medications** | Reopen an existing prescription and change dose/frequency/instructions on its medication requests |
| 3 | **Remove a Medication Before It's Dispensed** | Delete a not-yet-persisted draft row, or mark an existing request "Entered in Error" |
| 4 | **Discontinue a Medication** | Stop a single active medication (→ status `Ended`), or discontinue a whole group of medications sharing the same product |
| 5 | **View Medication Requests** | The Medicines → Prescriptions list/table for an encounter |
| 6 | **Print a Prescription** | Print one prescription or all prescriptions for an encounter |

**Deliberately out of scope** (separate FHIR-adjacent resources, would get their own concept/flow docs later, only cross-linked here): Medicine Administration (recording actual doses given), Medication Statement (patient-reported history), Medication Dispense / Pharmacy Prescription Queue (inventory/pharmacy side).

## Key attributes & status labels (verified)

- **Status** (`medication_status__*`): Active, On Hold, Ended, Cancelled, Completed, Entered in Error, Draft, Unknown
- **Intent**: `proposal`, `plan`, `order`, `original_order`, `reflex_order`, `filler_order`, `instance_order` — has a select in the UI but **no i18n label**, just capitalized raw value (e.g., "Original order"). Default `order`.
- **Priority** (`routine`/`urgent`/`asap`/`stat`) and **Category** (`inpatient`/`outpatient`/`community`/`discharge`) — both exist on the model but have **no UI control**; every prescription is silently `routine` / `inpatient`.
- Dosage sub-fields shown in the form: Dose, Frequency (required), Duration, PRN toggle + reason, Route, Site, Method, Additional instructions, Patient instruction, Requester, Note.

## Ambiguities that need your call

1. **"On Hold" has no reachable UI action** — only Discontinue (→ Ended) and Entered-in-Error are available. Should the docs mention "On Hold" as a status you may see but can't set from the UI, or omit it?
2. **`status_reason`, `priority`, `category` have no UI controls at all.** Document as "system-set, not editable" or omit entirely as internal detail?
3. **"Prescription" grouping construct** — a CARE-specific grouping of medication requests (not a distinct FHIR resource). Should Flow 2 ("Edit a Prescription's Medications") explicitly explain what a Prescription is, or should that live in `concept.md` only?
4. Should **Flow 6 (Print)** be one doc covering both "print one" and "print all", or split into two flow docs?
5. Any interest in a short **"Add a medication from a patient's history"** sub-flow as its own doc, or folded into Flow 1?

## Code issues logged (not acting on these yet)

- Intent select bypasses i18n (raw string transform).
- `priority`/`category` fields exist but have no UI to set them.
- `status_reason` enum has zero i18n coverage and zero UI wiring — looks unfinished.
- Single `PUT update` API route appears unused (all edits go through `upsert`).
- `MedicationRequestPrescription.approval_status` looks like dead/unused scaffolding (backend).
- `as_needed_boolean` required with no default in backend spec — easy to omit by mistake.

Let me know your answers to the 5 questions above (or just say "proceed as proposed") and I'll lock the flow list and move to writing.
